metadata.scenario_context: Several multinational companies are collaborating on a project and have decided to hold a joint meeting in early January to assess progress.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from China disagree that having the army rule is bad.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Czechia agree that having the army rule is bad.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss the possibility of holding the joint meeting on January 4th.
agent_1.goal_2: Question the attitude toward having army rule.

agent_2.goal_1: Discuss setting a specific date for the meeting.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss whether it is common to have the army rule.
